title: Info Support has the emptiest app-layer slot of the Dutch firms but a .NET culture
content:
Info Support is described as the best-evidenced Dutch firm in the set and a genuine custom house, meaning nothing of its own occupies the application layer and there is no internal product to displace. On the two structural questions the screen cares about — evidence quality and an empty app-layer slot — it scores as well as any Dutch lead.

The offset is culture rather than capability. It is a .NET and Azure house, which costs it on technical affinity; its stack was not otherwise researched. Affinity matters because a first partner's engineers have to be able to read and extend what gets built, and a bench whose daily language is C# will experience a TypeScript-based stack as a new thing to learn rather than as an extension of what it already does.

At 500+ people it is also above the size where one conversation decides. The result is a strong lead held at priority 3 for reasons that are about friction rather than doubt.
